scope: Single-crown strawberry morphology hypothesis informed by several photographs. Six trifoliate leaves and a separate fruit truss. No reconstruction, measured stiffness, roots, cutting or harvest-policy claim.

evidence.feature: Standing plant: petioles remain ascending through most of their length; cupped leaf faces and central developing leaves
evidence.condition: Figure 1, field-grown plant; adjacent plants overlap; dimensions not recovered

evidence.feature: Layered petiole bases and main/branch crowns
evidence.condition: Plant held apart by hands; not evidence for natural attachment angles; this candidate has one crown

evidence.feature: Short compressed crown, overlapping bases, roots below crown
evidence.condition: Trimmed bare-root specimen; cannot identify growth posture or mechanical constants

evidence.feature: Young nursery-potted plants support another canopy/central-growth comparison
evidence.condition: Different cultivar/stage/container; not a metric matched specimen

evidence.feature: Age-stratified effective Young modulus, 89 / 194 / 297 MPa, new / second / third-and-older leaves
evidence.condition: Tsubota et al. 2022, Tochiotome cultivar in forcing culture. Effective modulus inferred from axial buckling under specified supports; not a direct calibration of our bent, tapered segments. Values stated in PDF p.229; setup described on p.232.

parameter_status.unloaded_geometry: explicit visual hypothesis; photos show loaded geometry, so rest shape remains unidentified
parameter_status.attachment_coordinates: assumed staggered crown-relative coordinates in metres
parameter_status.material_properties: Age-stratified petiole modulus uses published buckling-derived values as a prior. Mapping our leaf ages to those ranks is assumed. Truss and leaf blade material laws remain unchanged/assumed.
parameter_status.leaf_mass: assumed areal-density scaling; no specimen measurements
parameter_status.distributions: bounded engineering hypotheses, not biological statistics

crown_structure.status: compressed stem with staggered petiole bases; fixed boundary; dimensions assumed

leaves.modulus_status: literature-derived prior; specimen and test-mode transfer unvalidated

dependencies: one size variable changes petiole length/radius, leaf area/mass, and fruit dimensions/volume/mass
one openness variable changes leaf endpoint radius without moving crown attachments or substrate
one azimuth variable rotates the leaf arrangement together; fruit truss fixed for probe comparability
Age-dependent petiole modulus remains fixed across morphology seeds; crown/root boundary and leaf hinge law remain uncalibrated.
variation.status: uncalibrated bounded hypotheses; seeded variants are simulation holdouts, not proof of real-world generalization
